name: Sabin Center, Opposition to Renewable Energy Facilities in the United States: September 2026 Edition
update_cadence: annual editions (6th edition published 2026-09-02, data through 2025-12-31); web database updated monthly
notes: Seeds the Sabin rows of restrictions_seed.csv and contested_projects_seed.csv (scripts/build_sabin_seeds.py), read from data/renewable_opposition_records_2026-09.csv (scripts/extract_sabin_edition.py). Extracted from the Sabin Center's own export and web edition at oppositionreport.org/reports/current/ (stored in data/raw/); the report PDF (scholarship.law.columbia.edu/sabin_climate_change/280/) was blocked for this session and is still to be added to data/raw/. 2025 REC- ids are kept through data/review/sabin_edition_crosswalk.csv. Reports at least 888 restrictions and 567 contested projects; reconciliation in docs/sabin_2026_reconciliation.md. The June 2025 edition (data/renewable_opposition_records.csv) is still read for records not in the 2026 edition.

name: NREL U.S. Wind Siting Regulation and Zoning Ordinances (2025)
notes: Fetched by scripts/fetch_nrel_ordinances.py (schema guard) into data/raw/; scripts/nrel_ordinances.py builds siting_standards and NREL restrictions by the shared severity rules. Compiled with large language models (INFRA-COMPASS); every row unverified until its ordinance is reviewed. Accuracy sample: docs/nrel_sample_report.md.

name: LBNL Laws in Order: An Inventory of State Renewable Energy Siting Policies (2024)
notes: Locates state siting law for state_policies (data/review/state_policies_candidates.csv). Never the verification: each row is checked against the statute itself. PDF read from eta-publications.lbl.gov/sites/default/files/rap-enterline-valainis-laws-order-inventory-state-renewable-energy-siting-policies-2024-june.pdf (the landing pages block scripts).

name: EIA-860M Preliminary Monthly Electric Generator Inventory
technology_scope: solar, wind, battery_storage, geothermal (plants of 1 MW or more)
notes: scripts/fetch_facilities.py keeps the newest monthly workbook's solar, wind, storage and geothermal plants (Operating, Planned, Retired, Canceled or Postponed tabs) in data/reference/facilities.csv; the workbook itself is not committed, its URL, release and SHA-256 are in data/reference/facilities_manifest.csv. scripts/facility_matches.py matches contested projects to plants; a match never changes an outcome. Refreshed monthly by build-data.yml.

name: U.S. Wind Turbine Database (USWTDB)
notes: Turbines grouped by project, state and EIA plant id in data/reference/facilities.csv (scripts/fetch_facilities.py). Built projects only; adds wind projects under 1 MW and turbine locations.

name: U.S. Large-Scale Solar Photovoltaic Database (USPVDB)
technology_scope: solar (built facilities of 1 MW or more)
notes: One row per built facility in data/reference/facilities.csv (scripts/fetch_facilities.py), digitized from imagery.
